pf.license.need: none from the state for enrichment or tutoring in most places; where the state licenses a child-care or after-school program, the business shows its own license only once it is on file; teachers hold the certificates the business says they hold (the business's own word)
pf.license.who: the business, for its registration and any child-care or after-school license; each teacher, for their own certificate or background check where the rules ask
pf.license.ask: the business registration; any child-care license number; each teacher's certificate and its end date
pf.license.check: Rosie checks no license, certificate or background check: each one is the business's own word, shown as that, never as a state license or as checked
pf.license.scope: a teacher is offered only for the programs and ages the owner says they may teach
pf.license.blocks: goes live on identity and the business's registration; a teacher is offered once the owner says yes
pf.license.renewals: certificates reminded 30 and 7 days before; a lapsed one the owner reports takes that teacher off new classes
pf.license.insurance: liability insurance: the business's own word, shown once it is sent
pf.license.background: background checks for every teacher and volunteer who works with children: the business's own word, where the rules ask

pf.services.shape: class: a seat in a term or a drop-in session for one child, with a set number of places by age; a home or school session books a teacher for a group of children at the customer's place (flow B)
pf.services.examples: the example program's own prices (Lee Learning Lab and Lee Kids Club), not a standard

list.name: After-school term (10 weeks, two afternoons a week)
list.kind: one price per child for the term
list.before: a $60 deposit when enrolling, the rest charged to the saved card at the end of the term

list.name: Holiday program day
list.kind: one price per child per day
list.note: a child picked up after 5:00pm is charged the late fee, paid at the desk

list.name: Free visit to see the program
list.before: nothing taken; a yes by text

list.name: Home science club (up to 6 children)
list.before: a card saved for the $40 fee
list.after: the saved card charged when the teacher texts DONE

list.name: In-school enrichment program (per child, a term)
list.length: one class a week for 10 weeks
list.after: one bill to the school after the term

pf.services.intro: a free look at the program for a child: a parent comes in with the child for 45 minutes, nothing is taken
pf.services.capacity: places per term or class by age, set by the room and the teachers' limit (12 children per teacher)
pf.services.minimum: a term runs with 6 children; too few before it starts: Sam runs it or cancels, and each family gets a full refund
pf.services.waitlist: a full term keeps a waitlist; a freed place goes by text to one family at a time
pf.services.skills: homework help, science, art, reading, coding, sports, music; the age groups each teacher may work with
pf.services.nobodyHome: never: a child is never left without a listed adult to pick them up

beforeTimes: which program, and the start date
how many children, for a home or school program
a term or a drop-in visit
afterTime: anything the teacher should know: a learning need, a language, a fear or a food allergy
securePage: the child's name, age and a waiver, read and signed by the parent or guardian
health notes: allergies, asthma, a seizure note, medicine they carry
an emergency contact and who may pick the child up (a list of adults)
pf.questions.whoMayBook: a parent or guardian for each child; a school's office books an in-school program; a child is never booked by someone who isn't on the child's record
pf.questions.told: the program, the hours, the pick-up rule (only listed adults), and what to bring

stop.words: a child not breathing, unresponsive, or hurt badly right now
stop.say: Call 911 now. Keep the child still, and start first aid if trained.

goOn.words: a learning need, asthma, a food allergy, or a recent injury
goOn.what: the booking goes on; the answer stays on the secure page, and the teacher reads it before the program; Rosie gives no health advice

goOn.words: a child who finds school hard after a loss or a move
goOn.what: the booking goes on, kindly; a teacher may call the parent; crisis words get the crisis line

pf.safety.inClass: a child becomes unwell or is hurt: the teacher gives first aid, calls 911 if it's serious, calls the parent at once, and the owner is told; nothing about it goes in a text

steps.name: Waiver on the secure page
steps.result: not signed in 10 minutes: nothing is booked

steps.name: Pick-up list on the secure page
steps.result: no adult on the list: the child isn't released at pick-up

steps.name: Health questions on the secure page
steps.result: the booking goes on; any yes is read by the teacher before the first day

pf.first_steps.prep: a snack, a water bottle, and clothes the child can get messy in; a photo ID for the adult who picks up

pf.visit.checkIn: the teacher ticks each child on the roster at the door when the parent drops them off
pf.visit.lateEntry: a child may join up to 30 minutes after the start; after that the place may go to someone waiting
pf.visit.changes: an extra day or an extra hour is priced first and the parent says yes; nothing is added to a term
pf.visit.leaveEarly: a child who leaves early pays the full price: the place was theirs
pf.visit.done: the teacher texts DONE once the last child is picked up

pf.money.before: a term: a $60 deposit when enrolling, the rest charged to the saved card at the end of the term; a holiday day and a drop-in visit paid in full when booking; a home science club: a card saved for the $40 fee, charged when the teacher texts DONE; an in-school program: nothing before, one bill after the term
pf.money.after: everything is settled before, at the desk, or on the saved card at the end; nothing is billed later except a school's bill
pf.money.cancel: a term: free to cancel before it starts; after it starts, the deposit may be kept only with the owner's yes; a drop-in or a holiday day: free up to 24 hours before
pf.money.fees: late pick-up after 5:00pm: a late fee, paid at the desk; a late cancel or no-show: the $40 fee at a home, only with the owner's yes; the owner confirms each fee
pf.money.caps: deposits and prepayments within the state's limits where they apply
pf.money.tax: any sales tax the state requires, in the price before the yes
pf.money.fee2: Rosfield's $2 per confirmed booking applies: one $2 per booking, however many children

pf.messages.never: a child's name and age, health notes, a learning need or a pick-up detail in texts to anyone but the parent: only on the secure page
pf.messages.staffTexts: the teacher's day list shows the program and the number of children; names open on the secure page
pf.messages.minors: texts go to the parent or guardian who booked

pf.staff.licenses: each teacher's certificate or background check, the business's own word, never checked by Rosie
pf.staff.skills: homework help, science, art, reading, coding, sports, music; the age groups each teacher may work with
pf.staff.ratio: up to 12 children per teacher; younger children at 8 per teacher
pf.staff.standIn: another teacher the owner has cleared for the age group; a home or school program that named a teacher is asked first, and nobody moves on silence
pf.staff.oks: the owner OKs late pick-ups, extra days, home and school programs and refunds

pf.rules.showFacts: the program, the hours, the pick-up rule, the cancel terms and the deposit before the yes
pf.rules.cancelRight: no cancel period for a day or a visit already given; a term follows its signed terms
pf.rules.pickup: a child is released only to an adult on the pick-up list; anyone else waits while the parent is called, and a teacher never drives a child
pf.rules.waiver: what a waiver may say, where the state limits it; the state form sets the words
pf.rules.records: waivers, health notes and pick-up lists kept with the booking for 7 years, or longer where the state asks
pf.rules.reviews: a rating once after the term

pf.edges.tooFew: too few before a term starts: Sam runs it or cancels; each family gets a full refund
pf.edges.full: a full term: the waitlist, in order; a freed place goes by text for 30 minutes
pf.edges.late: a child who arrives late joins up to 30 minutes after the start; after that the place may go to someone waiting
pf.edges.teacherOut: another cleared teacher covers the same program at the same time
pf.edges.noPickup: no listed adult comes by closing time: the teacher stays with the child, calls the parent, then the emergency contact; the owner is told
pf.edges.unwell: a child looks unwell or is hurt: the teacher gives first aid, calls 911 if it's serious, calls the parent, and the owner is told; nothing in a text
pf.edges.other: all other edge cases the generic way
